scope: Same-binary full/page API contract comparison; separate off/on opt-in read-ahead comparison. This is not a comparison with an old main binary or a production capacity measurement. Each trial restarts the native process, resets only its dedicated Redis, and runs common full/page/export integrity warm-up. Redis and rebuild counter deltas include before/after integrity; resource sampling covers k6. No compiler/browser activity overlaps.

failedPreflight.reason: 200 rps full-board JSON parsing saturated the shared load generator; retained separately, never treated as a capacity limit or optimization result. Subsequent matched runs use 10 rps on both sides, with unchanged acceptance thresholds.

preReview.reason: These earlier API trials passed their load gates, but review subsequently found a too-tight page-route query budget and page-bound team-dialog selection. Both were reproduced and fixed before the final campaign, which also accepts the full validated Unicode team-name length. Its disposable fixture had the same shape; no old-versus-new binary performance claim is made.

reviewRegressions.queryBudget: Before: unexpected HTTP 429 after the query burst. After: cached pages do not spend Query, the CTFtime Query limit remains, and Global still rejects request 151.
reviewRegressions.selection: Before: returning team reopened details without user action. After: desktop/compact dialogs survive a row move, close explicitly, and cannot reopen on row return. Unit coverage clears game/viewer selection.
reviewRegressions.unicodeLookup: The lookup byte bound derives from the existing 128-character team-name validator and accepts 128 four-byte Unicode scalars (512 UTF-8 bytes).

production: Not deployed: this environment has no configured production SSH/VPN credentials.
